subject: Re: Marot kickoff — staffing + compute asks
body:
Lucia,

Resourcing as requested.

Staffing: Freya 50% (TL), Ondrej 40% on the score-computation and sigtests code paths, Yara 30% on the Evalline/BLEURT bridge. Hosting lands on Shipyard, Zeke's team has the intake.

Compute: the app itself is client-side, but the BLEURT backfill is not — rescoring the historical MQM archive (about 2.1M segments across 14 language pairs) needs real accelerator time. We hold the vulcan-h100 reservation — 128 accelerators for the week of 2026-07-06 — to run the full backfill in one pass before the adoption push. I've confirmed the slot in the reservation sheet.

Smaller ongoing scoring fits titan-a100 best-effort.

One heads-up: rater data ingestion needs a privacy review (2-3 week SLA), filing this week so it clears well before July.

Deshawn
